description: MongoDB stores data in documents. A document is like a card with named facts, such as a book title and page count. Learn to add, find and change these cards. Later, count groups of records and link related data. Use a practice database and the tools in the setup lesson. MongoDB commands do not run in the browser playground on this site.
versionNote: Targets MongoDB 8.0 with mongosh 2.x and the Node.js driver 6.x. MongoDB 6.0 and 7.0 behave the same for everything covered here unless a lesson says otherwise.
whatYouWillLearn: Find documents using a simple rule
Choose careful access rules for data
learningObjectives: Name the fields in a small document
Add one book to a practice collection
Read the title from a stored book

seo.title: MongoDB Tutorial: Learn with Small Steps
seo.description: Learn MongoDB with small examples of documents, collections, searches and updates. Read the lessons, then try practice questions and a quiz.
